# FreeCAD MCP

> FreeCAD-based CAD operations via FastMCP 3.2 server — STEP/STL conversion, BIM (walls/slabs/columns/doors/windows/roofs), CFD/OpenFOAM fluid simulation, FluidX3D GPU CFD, FEM structural analysis (CalculiX), PrusaSlicer G-code, marketplace search (Printables/Thingiverse/GrabCAD), and persistent CAD file depot with full CRUD.

## Tools (32 total)

### Core CAD
- `freecad_status` — FreeCAD availability + version
- `step_to_stl` — STEP/STP assembly to STL mesh
- `model_info` — Object count, solids, volume, bounding box
- `create_shape` — Box/cylinder/sphere/cone to STL
- `freecad_gui` — Launch FreeCAD desktop app
- `cad_depot` — List persistent CAD depot files with metadata
- `cad_create` — Create shape and save STL to depot

### BIM / Architecture
- `bim_create_wall` — Parametric wall (length, height, thickness)
- `bim_create_slab` — Floor slab
- `bim_create_column` — Rectangular/circular/H-section column
- `bim_create_window` — Window in auto-generated wall
- `bim_create_door` — Door in auto-generated wall
- `bim_create_roof` — Sloped or flat roof
- `bim_export_ifc` — FCStd to IFC export
- `bim_import_ifc` — IFC import to FCStd

### CFD / OpenFOAM (Docker)
- `cfd_status` — Docker + image availability
- `cfd_create_domain` — Parametric channel/pipe/nozzle
- `cfd_configure_physics` — Solver, turbulence, fluid properties
- `cfd_set_boundary` — Boundary conditions (14 types)
- `cfd_build_case` — Validate case completeness
- `cfd_run_solver` — blockMesh + solver via Docker
- `cfd_read_results` — Forces, residuals, convergence
- `cfd_parametric_study` — Parameter sweeps for ML datasets
- `cfd_nl2foam` — Natural language to OpenFOAM case
- `cfd_sample_for_pinns` — Point cloud export for PINN training

### FluidX3D (GPU CFD)
- `cfd_fluidx3d_status/prebuilt/setup/compile/run/results/explain`

### FEM / Structural
- `fem_status/create_analysis/set_material/set_constraint/mesh/run/read_results`
- `run_fem_analysis` — End-to-end FEM pipeline

### 3D Printing
- `slicer_status` — PrusaSlicer availability
- `slice_stl` — STL to G-code

### Marketplace
- `marketplace_search` — Search Printables, Thingiverse, GrabCAD
- `marketplace_download` — Download model to depot
- `marketplace_categories` — List categories per source

## Prompts
- `freecad_expert` — Get FreeCAD expertise and tool guidance
- `freecad_convert_step` — Convert a STEP file to STL mesh

## Resources
- `cad://depot` — List all files in persistent depot
- `cad://depot/{filename}` — Get info about a depot file

## Architecture
- Backend: FreeCAD 1.1.1+ (TCP bridge + subprocess fallback)
- CFD: OpenFOAM via Docker, FluidX3D via OpenCL
- FEM: CalculiX via Docker
- Slicing: PrusaSlicer 2.8+
- Persistent depot: %LOCALAPPDATA%\freecad-mcp\depot
- REST API: http://localhost:10944/api/v1/
- Webapp: http://localhost:10945
- FreeCAD bridge: port 10946 (internal)
